title: Roll Call
description: let the horror roll call begin
body: Roll Call is a horror sandbox modpack that throws you into a living, unscripted nightmare where legendary horror icons and disturbing original entities roam freely, each with their own strengths and behaviors. You choose your role: become an Observer, documenting these terrifying encounters by photographing and studying them to build a chilling archive, or step into the role of a Hunter, gearing up to track and eliminate them using strategy, knowledge, and careful preparation.
